text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival,
Chrono Genesis and the rest of the PR Committee were displaying the school newspaper.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here it is!
The Tracen Academy History Column exhibition!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Whoa, incredible! Not just the column, but related photos and even a timeline! So detailed~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
H-Here... we also have a new column
focusing on the Takarazuka Kinen... s-so please, have a look.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I came to get this!
I thought it'd be good reference for the fan vote.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! P-Please...
use this to help decide your vote...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hello~.
Chrono-chan, how is the reaction to the exhibition?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Thanks to you... it's more lively than in previous years.
Especially... the exhibition featuring the Umamusume who excelled last year is being read with great enthusiasm...
choice_data_list: Everyone's picking up the newly distributed column too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Still... most of them were people
who had already been reading my column..."
Grass spotted, deesu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I wondered where you'd disappeared off to,
and here you are with your cute junior after all, YES?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is El Condor Pasa.
An Umamusume known for her Latin flair and signature mask.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"We're having a serious discussion right now~.
Please wait outside, El."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's so mean, death!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I heard you, yes!
You want to attract people to your exhibit, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Then we just need to make some flashy publicity, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Compete in an event and entertain the crowd! Just like promo mic work in pro wrestling!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Big laughs! Big win! Crowds rush in!
No doubt about it, dess!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...!
I'll look for an event where I can really stand out...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all!
The "Big Eater Challenge" is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple: we compare the weight of what we ate!
Participants are free to eat whatever they want.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Your MC is me, the White Lightning, Tamamo Cross! Alright then, bring on the challengers!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Can't leave this one out of a big eating contest.
It's the appetite monster, Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I heard we could eat a lot,
so I came on an empty stomach. I'm starving."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She's got what it takes for the big stage!
Will the dark horse pull it off? Here comes Hishi Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, I couldn't resist the participation prize~.
Even though I can't really eat that much.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If it makes things fun, anythin' goes!
Go ahead and cause some chaos, Gold Ship!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All you bored slackers who came to watch a race whose outcome was obvious from the start!
I'm gonna show you a damn good time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The monster Oguri Cap, the completely averaaage Umamusume Hishi Miracle, and the rule-breaking Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"In the final stretch, fighting spirit is number one!
Show 'em your guts, Chrono Genesis!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm Chrono Genesis from the Public Relations Committee...
Our committee is holding an exhibit featuring
a column series on racing history...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
We also have introductions for Umamusume to help with fan voting.
P-Please come and take a look...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're... doing this for publicity!?
Well, aren't you refreshingly shameless about it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last, the big-eating challenge has begun!
However—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle's okonomiyaki is
packed with toppings and looks delicious.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, it's a special okonomiyaki with every single one of my favorite toppings on it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: With all the toppings, huh? I'll have to try that next time.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: *chew, chew*.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan's cooking is so well-balanced
nutritionally, it's just ideal~."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I was taught that good running starts with good meals...
so I make it a point to chew thoroughly
and savor every bite...
choice_data_list: They look so peaceful while eating...

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Normally, big-eating events have a time limit,
but this time there was none set.
Since it wasn't a speed-eating contest, this was the proper way, but it was an unexpected turn of events.

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to ask what brought this on all of a sudden, but...
yeah, I just can't let that slide without a comment.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa! Is this place an aquarium or what!?
Are the gangsters of the sea playing nice and having fun now!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You gotta be kidding me!
I've got my suction cups out, and I'm gonna rattle 'em!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Take this!
Secret Technique: Golden Ship's Infinite Treasure!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's the illegal move!
Golshi's food is making a massive migration onto everyone else's plates!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Golshi!
Don't mind if I do.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: S-So this is Golshi-san's legendary technique... one that will go down in racing history...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Such a precious experience... I am truly honored.
I-I must return the favor in kind...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, me too~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"A return of goodwill from Chrono and Hishi Miracle!
Paid back double!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
S-S-Stooop!
Acts of kindness are super effective against meee!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-chan, want to trade
some of our food?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
Would 100 grams of each be all right...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: O-Oguri-san, would you... like some too...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? I'm so happy...
Thank you for the food!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow... this is nice.
Feels like a cozy, heartwarming lunch..."

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. She's always so cool during races, but...
she has a cute side off the track, too."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's not totally hypin' up, but
they seem to be enjoyin' it, so it's all good!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I forgot to set a time limit or anythin'!
It's all goin' strictly according to plan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Chrono Genesis's big-eating challenge
left a thoroughly positive impression on the fans!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I only came because the big eater challenge caught my eye,
but... this exhibition is really something!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Mejiro Palmer's 'Takarazuka Kinen'!
Her wire-to-wire runaway in the Arima is famous, but
that was only possible because of the Takarazuka!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right...
This column also mainly focuses on the process
of arriving at the front runner strategy...

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-san wrote this?
Man, that runaway lead really was something—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis is having a lively chat with the fans.
This exhibition is sure to have a positive impact
on the Takarazuka Kinen fan vote!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's the illegal move!
Golshi's food is making a massive migration onto Chrono's plate!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: S-So this is Golshi-san's legendary technique... one that will go down in racing history...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you for such a precious experience...
I'll savor every bit of it...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: *chew, chew, chew*.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...So this is the legendary taste...
Fufu, it's so delicious..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...S-Stop it...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: *chew, chew, chew*.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
S-S-Stooop!
Normal, decent treatment hurts me way too much...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Faced with such unyielding seriousness,
Golshi finally throws in the towel!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Man, giving a serious response to a joke is just brutal...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Chrono... you're so calm about it,
but you sure are packin' away a ton of food."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During last year's summer training camp,
Chrono Genesis had increased her food intake
as part of her physical conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has now reached a condition where she can sculpt
the optimal physique tailored specifically to the race!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Seeing someone eat with such gusto is great...!
And she's making it look so delicious, too!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Just watching them makes you so happy~!
It makes me wanna say, "Eat up, eat up~" ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Chrono Genesis's big-eating challenge
left a thoroughly positive impression on the fans!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I got curious after that big eater challenge
and came over, but... this exhibition is really something!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Silence Suzuka-san's Takarazuka Kinen!
I remember that brilliant wire-to-wire win!
She looked like she was having so much fun running, you know?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-That's true, isn't it...
Even though it was a 5-race winning streak and a first GⅠ victory,
the only comment was about the view from the front...

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
You wrote this, Chrono?!
Hey, is Suzuka like that at Tracen Academy too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis is having a lively chat with the fans.
This exhibition is sure to have a positive impact
on the Takarazuka Kinen fan vote!
